numberingPolicy.question: Use app reference 983b, prominently retain printed reference 1030, and follow the same suffix convention for future omissions? This decides numbering only; wording review stays separate.

convention.newReference: Use the existing suffix convention, starting with b after the preceding app reference and advancing to the next unused letter for further distinct printed occurrences.

limits: Numbering only; does not approve transcription, translation, reuse rights, narration or external publication.
Each added report still needs its own complete source record, two printed witnesses, exact location, comparison limits and explicit personal-prototype admission.

witnessCorrections.reading: وقال الأويسي حدثني محمد بن جعفر عن يحيى بن سعيد وشريك سمعا أنسا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم رفع يديه حتى رأيت بياض إبطيه
witnessCorrections.differenceNote: The historical print writes the honorific in full and proceeds directly to rafa‘a (raised), without annahu (that he). The selected modern print includes annahu. The gloss immediately before this chain belongs to the previous report.

originalCandidate.reason: Both inspected prints contain the al-Uwaysi report after the account at selected reference 983 and before the next chapter and selected reference 984. originalCandidate.transcriptionPolicy: AI manual unvowelled transcription. Vowel marks, report/chapter numbers, ornament, quotation punctuation and editorial cross-references are excluded. witnesses.reading: وقال الأويسي حدثني محمد بن جعفر عن يحيى بن سعيد وشريك سمعا أنسا عن النبي ﷺ أنه رفع يديه حتى رأيت بياض إبطيه

workingEnglish.chain: And al-Uwaysi said: Muhammad ibn Ja‘far told me, from Yahya ibn Sa‘id and Sharik, who both heard Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ,
workingEnglish.report: that he raised his hands until I saw the whiteness of his armpits.

comparisonLimits.note: Its Arabic contains this separate chain and first-person I saw. Its English abbreviates the chain and uses a passive description; that change is not copied. This is not evidence of reuse or narration rights.

The deprecated 2.17.140 label displayed on Sunnah.com is not a content match to the pinned EPUB record with that number: the EPUB 140 is the Abdullah ibn Zayd cloak report. The missing al-Uwaysi occurrence is absent between checked EPUB 140 and 141.
The checked page moves directly from the bedouin account to chapter XXI and 984. It has no separate al-Uwaysi report.
